D: Po faces a peacock warlord with a deadly new weapon and finally learns where he came from.
P: Serve the buns when Po tries to fit them all in his mouth.
S: the radish crate baby Po was found in
Daikon and carrot cut into batons, pickled quickly in rice vinegar, sugar and salt, served cold and crunchy.
the bean bun challenge, how many fit at once
Soft steamed buns filled with sweet red bean paste, steamed for 12 minutes until puffy and pillowy.
Prawn crackers puffed in hot oil in seconds and tossed with chilli salt and a little five spice.
M: the noodle shop where Po grew up
Fresh egg noodles in a rich chicken broth with bok choy, spring onion, shiitake and a soft egg on top.
Chicken thighs stir-fried with dried chillies, Sichuan pepper, garlic and peanuts in a sweet soy glaze.
W: for the peaches of the Valley of Peace
Steamed buns shaped like peaches and tinted pink at the tip, filled with sweet lotus or red bean paste.
K: Chilled Chinese sour plum drink with hawthorn and osmanthus, sweet, sour and smoky. Simmer 6 dried smoked plums, a few dried hawthorn slices and 1 tsp dried osmanthus in 1.5L water for 40 minutes.

s.note: the radish crate baby Po was found in
s.how: Cut 400g daikon and 2 carrots into thin batons. Warm 250ml rice vinegar with 3 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp salt until dissolved, cool, pour over the vegetables and pickle in the fridge for at least 1 hour before serving cold.

s.note: the bean bun challenge, how many fit at once
s.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g dried yeast, 40g sugar and 220ml warm milk into a smooth dough and prove 1 hour. Divide into 12, fill each with a spoon of red bean paste (300g total) and pinch closed. Prove 20 minutes, then steam 12 minutes until puffed.

m.note: the noodle shop where Po grew up
m.how: Simmer 1.5L chicken stock with 150g sliced shiitake for 10 minutes. Boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel. Cook 400g egg noodles and divide into 4 bowls, add 2 halved bok choy blanched in the broth, ladle over the stock and top with halved eggs and sliced spring onion.

w.note: for the peaches of the Valley of Peace
w.how: Make a dough of 300g flour, 5g yeast, 30g sugar and 170ml warm water and prove 1 hour. Shape 10 balls around red bean paste (250g total), pinch a point and score a crease like a peach. Steam 12 minutes, then dab the tips with a little red colouring.

d.how: Simmer 6 dried smoked plums, a few dried hawthorn slices and 1 tsp dried osmanthus in 1.5L water for 40 minutes. Strain, sweeten with 100g rock sugar and chill. Serve over ice.
